name: blueprint/device-ping
description: Local device heartbeats: ping through rh_run, one receipt per device, alert once on a failure streak - the heartbeat pattern on the user's own network
recipe: register the device with its host -> ping on the cadence -> receipt per ping -> failure streak: notify once
pitfalls: rh_run reaches local hosts by design - the SSRF public-only rule guards guardedFetch, not the user's own commands
exit codes are the health signal, verbatim
alert-once record dedupes the streak notify
ping flags differ per OS - keep the argv portable
